product.title: Big Island Highlights: Coffee, Volcano, Black Sands & Waterfall

description.text: Spend a full day exploring the Big Island with visits to waterfalls, beaches, tropical valleys, stunning viewpoints, and so much more. Learn about Kona’s coffee culture with a visit to Greenwell Coffee Farm, for an insider's perspective and to sample the locally cultivated coffee. Stops include Greenwell Farms, Punalu'u Black Sand Beach, Rainbow Falls. See Hawaii’s natural beauty at Punalu’u Black Sands Beach, where you can look out for Hawaiian green sea turtles, make multiple stops in Volcanoes National Park, and soak up the beauty of Rainbow Falls all in a day. Ideal for visitors touring Hawaii Volcanoes National Park who want a guided Big Island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
